role: announcement-compatible library decoding, forecast visibility and economic accounting preflight; no library rollout
registration_context: all 876 screen cells complete (872 new, four reused). The 0.45/0.75 pair succeeds in 73/73 windows in each 2024 sample under both rules; the 0.35/0.75 pair succeeds in April and fails every July/October window. Announced functional-library and monetary results remain unobserved

library.components: reuse the original 64 components, seed 20261799, 128 generator nodes, maximum frequency 40, 1000 interpolated nodes per channel and rounding by the existing policy_integer_levels=100 recipe
library.mapping: retain the V5 ordered component mapping, including the fixed 27-position functional pairing; 2000 coordinates are two ordered 1000-coordinate channels
library.reference_scope: the three extra shared references stay outside the joint library and cannot open its gate
library.constant_continuity: confirm decoded profile_0003/profile_0007 equal [0.35,0.75] and profile_0004/profile_0007 equal [0.45,0.75] at every node before treating the screen as evidence about encoded joint candidates
library.storage: reuse the roster and generator recipe; keep compact metadata rather than dumping all window-by-profile target arrays

forecast_targets.calibration: reuse the original 2022-only q05/q95 forecast level and q95 absolute half-hour ramp fit; no development refit
forecast_targets.stress: reuse the existing max(clipped normalized forecast level, clipped absolute forecast ramp) signal
forecast_targets.clock: at an eligible nomination t use the forecast for its PN delivery t+60 and the preceding half-hour forecast; both publish times must be <=t in actual window UTC coordinates
forecast_targets.channel: each unit interpolates its own original component on that available stress; do not substitute announced direction, prices, realized demand or optimized witness stocks for the original signal
forecast_targets.scope: construct and validate the nomination target schedule only; the current static-controller engine and all saved physical outcomes remain untouched during this preflight
forecast_targets.terminal: only the 338 eligible decisions 0..10110 for a 10200-minute task need target values; unused post-horizon delivery forecasts are not fabricated

input_boundary.required_extension: for each original sample, cover [source_sample_stop,source_sample_stop+120 minutes) at half-hour resolution: at most four additional slots per sample, 12 slots total, for prices and historical forecast/publish metadata
input_boundary.lookup: inspect existing raw forecast/market-index caches first; derived CSV cutoff alone does not establish a cache gap
input_boundary.small_public_fetch: if needed, retrieve only the missing three two-hour ranges through the same official Elexon historical endpoints and selection logic; retain request logs and the selected small records
input_boundary.preservation: write boundary records separately; leave original ten-day CSVs, all 73 source windows per sample and every original outcome intact
input_boundary.failure: unavailable historical forecast publication or incomplete actual execution-price coverage blocks the corresponding next rollout; retain the missing slots rather than extrapolating prices, using outturn as forecast or dropping windows

economic_accounting.objective: retain the V3 net metered procurement proxy plus terminal inventory adjustment in GBP
economic_accounting.metered_cash: sum each actual half-hour MID price times gross delivered import minus gross delivered export across both units; prices are accounting outcomes only
economic_accounting.terminal_adjustment: lambda_T = discharge_efficiency * MID in the last executed settlement interval; add lambda_T * (sum common initial SOC - sum final SOC)
economic_accounting.pulse_flow: reconstruct each saved pilot hour from its actual admitted peak and locked current/following PN; use exact 1/30/1 endpoints and sign-crossing integrals, including resumed PN and warmup
economic_accounting.pilot_cases: the four complete April start-zero pilots only, 680 saved hours; reconstruct endpoints and gross flows without repeating nominations, declarations, minute physics or full-window simulation
economic_accounting.required_agreement: reconstructed gross flows and final inventory balance must match saved pilot totals within the retained 1e-8 tolerance; each pair of identical admitted paths must have identical economic outcomes
economic_accounting.failures: failed or interrupted windows retain undefined full-window cost; this preflight does not rank profiles by costs conditional on different completion sets
economic_accounting.comparison_scope: economic output belongs to this announced analyst simulation and its 170-hour execution clock

outputs: boundary_request_log.json (only if new public requests occur)
tests: decoded constant continuity, two forecast channels, publication cutoff rejection, settlement-clock price assignment, exact signed pulse/PN energy and terminal adjustment; no rerun of unchanged policy regressions or the 876-cell screen
decision: after decoded-library, historical-visibility, complete price coverage and saved-pilot economic checks pass, freeze a bounded dynamic-target integration/component stage before any announced library matrix or source comparison; otherwise preserve the specific discrepancy and resolve it first
limitations: overlapping development windows, analyst-defined advance notice and reset inventory, two observed constant candidates and MID-indexed simulation accounting; this stage cannot establish functional-library reliability, source benefit, actual BM profits, independent confirmation or OR submission readiness
